subject: ginkgoleaf
name: 银杏叶
label: 扇形银杏叶
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One fan-shaped ginkgo leaf with a shallow central notch, slender stem and three broad radial veins.
Composition check: complete subject centered inside central 76% of square, generous clear margins. Bold flowing black contours and blank interiors. No shading, gray fill or texture. Leaf veins are a few large structural lines only, never dense branching.
